    • Field Detail

      • CFG_AUTOMATION_INTERFACE_VERSION_RANGE_STRING

        @PublishedApiVersionInfo(domainType=AUTOMATION_IF,
                         versionType=VERSION_RANGE)
public static final java.lang.String CFG_AUTOMATION_INTERFACE_VERSION_RANGE_STRING
        AutomationInterfaceVersionRange specifies the compatibility of Cfg Core Versions to external components automation scripts.

        This VersionRanges is used to determine which Automation scripts are compatible to the current Cfg5Core. The CFG_AUTOMATION_INTERFACE_VERSION_RANGE_STRING specifies the current version. The VersionRange should start at the last BreakingChange (e.g. MajorVersion 3.0.0) and end at the current Major.Minor Version incl. all patches
        Example: Current Version 1.9.0 => Range: [1.0.0,1.10)

        See Also:
        Constant Field Values

      • CFG_AUTOMATION_INTERFACE_VERSION_STRING

        @PublishedApiVersionInfo(domainType=AUTOMATION_IF,
                         versionType=VERSION)
public static final java.lang.String CFG_AUTOMATION_INTERFACE_VERSION_STRING
        AutomationInterfaceVersion specifies the current version of the Cfg Core to external components automation scripts.

        The AutomationInterfaceVersion version shall be incremented, when any PublishedAPI classes are changed.

        • Additions to classes => Increment Minor version
        • BreakingChanges to classes => Increment Major version

        The following version history is a mapping from Cfg-Core version to Cfg5 releases / MICROSAR releases:

        • 1.0.0: Cfg5.13 - AR4-R16
        • 1.1.0: Cfg5.14 - AR4-R17
        • 1.2.0: Cfg5.15 - AR4-R18
        • 1.3.0: Cfg5.16 S-5 - AR4-19
        • 1.4.0: Cfg5.16 - AR4-R19
        • 1.5.0: Cfg5.17 - AR4-R20
        • 1.6.0: Cfg5.18 - AR4-R21
        • 1.7.0: Cfg5.20 - AR4-R23
        • 1.8.0: Cfg5.21 - AR4-R24
        • 1.9.0: Cfg5.22 - AR4-R25

        See Also:
